solidworks_catalog_exposure.doc: Report which tools a given exposure mode would present to the model. Read-only; autonomous mode keeps only planning entry points and the necessary query tools, compat mode keeps every tool.

params.mode: Exposure mode: 'autonomous' for planning entry points plus query tools, or 'compat' for every tool. Defaults to 'compat'.

solidworks_simulation_create_study.doc: Create a static simulation study with a given name and report which entry point ran. Creates the study in the active document; an empty entry_name means no study was created, only static studies are supported, and the add-in loads on first use.

params.study_name: Name of the study to create; duplicates are not checked, so re-read with solidworks_simulation_list_studies to confirm what happened.

solidworks_simulation_list_studies.doc: List every simulation study in the active document as index and name pairs. Read-only; it returns names only and never COM objects, and a study whose name cannot be read still appears with an empty name, so an empty list really means there are no studies.

solidworks_simulation_find_study.doc: Find one simulation study by its exact name. Read-only; a missing name returns found false instead of raising, so test the found flag rather than the presence of a name.

params.study_name: Exact study name to look for.

solidworks_sheet_metal_create_base_flang.doc: Create a native base flange from a sketch, given thickness, bend radius and depth in millimetres. Creates a sheet-metal feature in the active part and raises instead of returning an empty object; only a closed contour is verified on this machine, because an open polyline path fails here.

params.sketch_name: Sketch name, or __current_selection__ to reuse the current selection instead of selecting by name.
params.thickness_mm: Sheet thickness in millimetres, which must be greater than 0.
params.bend_radius_mm: Bend radius in millimetres, which must be 0 or greater.
params.depth_mm: Base flange depth in millimetres, which must be greater than 0.
params.k_factor: K factor for the bend allowance, which must lie strictly between 0 and 1. Defaults to 0.42.
params.relief_ratio: Relief ratio, which must be greater than 0. Defaults to 0.5.
params.reverse_direction: Whether to reverse the depth direction. Defaults to false.
params.reverse_thickness: Whether to reverse which side the thickness is added to. Defaults to false.

solidworks_sheet_metal_create_one_bend.doc: Skip this tool, NOT USABLE on this machine: bend-line and fixed-face selection is still unsolved. The CreateDefinition(35) sketch-bend entry point itself is correct, but the call never gets as far as writing, so it modifies nothing in the part.

params.sketch_name: Name of the sketch holding the bend line; '__current_selection__' reuses the current selection.
params.bend_radius_mm: Bend radius in millimetres; ignored when use_default_radius is true.
params.reverse_direction: Whether to flip the bend direction. Defaults to false.
params.use_default_radius: Whether to use the part default bend radius instead of bend_radius_mm. Defaults to true.

solidworks_add_sketch_relation.doc: Add one geometric relation such as sgHORIZONTAL or sgCOINCIDENT to the current sketch selection. Modifies the active sketch; the sg prefix is optional and matching ignores case, and sgEQUAL or sgMIDPOINT do not exist and are rejected.

params.relation_type: Relation name: sgFIXED, sgHORIZONTAL, sgVERTICAL, sgCOLINEAR, sgPARALLEL, sgPERPENDICULAR, sgTANGENT, sgCONCENTRIC, sgSAMELENGTH, sgSYMMETRIC, sgATMIDDLE or sgCOINCIDENT, where the sg prefix is optional and matching ignores case.

solidworks_mirror_feature.doc: Mirror an existing feature about a named plane. Creates a mirrored feature in the active part; both names must match the feature tree exactly, and plane names follow the SolidWorks UI language, so on a localised install they are not the English names.

params.feature_name: Name of the feature to mirror, as it appears in the feature tree.
params.mirror_plane_name: Name of the mirror plane in the language of the SolidWorks UI, which on a localised install is not the English name.

solidworks_simulation_create_mesh_safely.doc: Mesh a study behind an element-size gate and a pre-solve memory gate. Modifies the study's mesh and then restores its mesh settings; read blocked when ok is false, since it names the gate that refused, and the memory estimate assumes the FFEPlus rule.

params.study_name: Name of an existing study, for example Study 1; empty uses the first study in the document. Defaults to empty.
params.units: Unit system: 0=SI metre, 1=English, 2=Metric millimetre, and the value must match the unit of element_size_mm. Defaults to 2.
params.element_size_mm: Global element size in millimetres, where 0 lets SolidWorks choose. Defaults to 0.0.
params.tolerance_mm: Mesh tolerance in millimetres, where 0 uses the document default. Defaults to 0.0.
params.memory_budget_gb: Refuse to build the mesh when the estimated solve memory exceeds this many gigabytes. Defaults to unset, which uses the document default.

solidworks_simulation_solver_type.doc: Read which solver a static study will use, for example FFEPlus or a direct solver. Read-only; the value can read back as automatic while a direct solver is chosen at solve time, and when the read fails ok is false with a reason instead of a guessed default.

params.study_name: Name of an existing study; empty uses the first study in the document. Defaults to empty.

solidworks_measure_selection.doc: Measure the entities in a declarative selection and return the measured values. Read-only apart from rebuilding the selection before measuring; minus one means that measure does not apply to the current selection, and a selection that is empty is refused.

params.arc_option: How an arc distance is measured: 0=center to center, 1=minimum distance, 2=maximum distance. Defaults to 1.
params.selection: Declarative selector: index:<n> for the n-th entity of the kind below, or __current_selection__; empty selects nothing and the call is refused. Defaults to empty.
params.selection_kind: Entity kind to measure: FACE, EDGE or VERTEX, matching the entity you want measured. Defaults to FACE.

solidworks_add_dimension.doc: Add one display dimension at the given text position to an entity chosen by a declarative selector. Creates a dimension in the active part; the position is given in millimetres and converted to metres, it works only on visible documents, and it is verified on a plain box but fails on a plate with a boss.

params.x_mm: X of the dimension text in millimetres; the official call takes metres and the conversion happens once here.
params.y_mm: Y of the dimension text in millimetres.
params.selector: Which entity to dimension: __current_selection__ for the existing selection, or index:<n> for the n-th entity of the kind below. Defaults to __current_selection__.
params.kind: Entity kind to select: EDGE, FACE or VERTEX. Defaults to EDGE.

solidworks_part_intersect.doc: Create an intersect feature from the selected solid bodies and planes in two official steps. Creates a feature in the active part; exclude takes comma-separated body indices, excluding the only body creates no feature, and the criterion is the body count plus the feature-tree growth.

params.selection: Declarative selection: __current_selection__, or comma-separated type:name pairs such as SOLIDBODY:Shell1 or PLANE:Plane6, where a missing type means SOLIDBODY. Defaults to __current_selection__.
params.cap_planar: Whether to cap the planar openings of a surface into a closed volume. Defaults to false.
params.region_type: Region type: intersecting (0), internal (1) or intersecting_and_internal (2). Defaults to intersecting_and_internal.
params.exclude: Zero-based body indices to exclude, comma separated; the tool pads the boolean array to the body count. Defaults to empty, which excludes nothing.
params.merge: Whether to merge all intersecting regions into one body. Defaults to true.
params.consume: Whether to remove the input surfaces from the feature tree, which changes the tree beyond adding the new feature. Defaults to false.

solidworks_weld_fillet_bead_report.doc: Insert a fillet weld bead and report whether the feature tree grew. Creates a weldment feature; the two edge indices select the intersecting edges, sizes are in millimetres and converted to metres, and it is not yet verified on a real machine, so a returned None does not prove failure.

params.edge_index_1: Zero-based index of the first intersecting edge. Defaults to 0.
params.edge_index_2: Zero-based index of the second intersecting edge. Defaults to 1.
params.size_mm: Weld leg size in millimetres, used for both sides. Defaults to 5.0.
params.length_mm: Weld length in millimetres, where 0 means the whole edge. Defaults to 0.0.
params.bead_type_1: First-side bead type: 0=full length, 1=intermittent, 2=staggered. Defaults to 0.
params.bead_type_2: Second-side bead type: 0=full length, 1=intermittent, 2=staggered. Defaults to 0.
params.penetration_value_1: First-side penetration value in millimetres, used only when penetration_type_1 is 1. Defaults to 0.0.
params.penetration_value_2: Second-side penetration value in millimetres, used only when penetration_type_2 is 1. Defaults to 0.0.
params.pitch_mm: Pitch in millimetres, used for intermittent or staggered beads. Defaults to 0.0.
params.flag: Weld flag: 0=single side without tangent propagation, 1=both sides, 2=tangent propagation, 3=both sides with tangent propagation. Defaults to 1.
